name: Showcase: every copilot capability on one stroke call
note: For rehearsal and screenshots: speech from the medic and family, a pill bottle that disagrees with what was said (label check), a monitor read by the camera, a spoken protocol request answered with the county's cited words, sharing with the receiving ED, and a later monitor frame with falling SpO2 (change alert). Photos are the synthetic test images in eval/photos (no patient data). LKW_TIME is filled by replay.py. Run without --fast.

steps.say: 68-year-old female, sudden right-sided weakness, husband says she was fine at LKW_TIME.
Right facial droop, right arm drift, eyes deviated to the left, she can't get her words out.
She takes Eliquis for her heart.
steps.speaker: husband

steps.note: the bottle reads warfarin: Herald flags that it disagrees with what the husband said

steps.say: Show me the protocol for stroke.
Glucose 142. Transporting to Regional, ETA 12 minutes.

steps.note: a later frame: SpO2 falls from 99 to 84 and the respiratory rate rises
